page_content.description:
The actual content of the result. The atypical (snake-case) field name is to maintain duck-type compatibility
with the langchain Document class.

rank.description: The rank given by the vector store search

score.description: The score given by the vector store search

sourcePassage.description: The SourcePassage from which this result is created.

additionalMetadata.description: Optional additional metadata associated with the sourcePassage.

title: A result of similarity search containing the page content, test, rank, score, the {@link Genai.SourcePassage} from which it was created, amd any meta-data.
name: Genai.Retriever.SimilaritySearchResult
